svg.aria-label: Muscles of the anterolateral abdominal wall (anterior view) — 腹前外侧壁的肌（前面观）

text.aria-label: Muscles of the anterolateral abdominal wall (anterior view) — 腹前外侧壁的肌（前面观）
text.tspan: Muscles of the anterolateral abdominal wall (anterior view)
腹前外侧壁的肌（前面观）

text.aria-label: A. Right external oblique, left internal oblique — A. 右侧腹外斜肌，左侧腹内斜肌
text.tspan: A. Right external oblique, left internal oblique
A. 右侧腹外斜肌，左侧腹内斜肌

text.aria-label: Inguinal ligament — 腹股沟韧带
Linea alba — 白线
The right external oblique and the left internal oblique lie on one diagonal: together they turn the trunk to the left. — 右侧腹外斜肌与左侧腹内斜肌的纤维连成一条斜线：两者一起使躯干向左转。
text.tspan: The right external oblique and the left internal oblique lie on one diagonal: together they turn the trunk to the left.
右侧腹外斜肌与左侧腹内斜肌的纤维连成一条斜线：两者一起使躯干向左转。

text.aria-label: B. Right rectus abdominis and pyramidalis, left transversus abdominis — B. 右侧腹直肌和锥状肌，左侧腹横肌
text.tspan: B. Right rectus abdominis and pyramidalis, left transversus abdominis
B. 右侧腹直肌和锥状肌，左侧腹横肌

text.aria-label: Tendinous intersections — 腱划
Linea semilunaris (lateral edge of rectus abdominis) — 半月线（腹直肌外侧缘）
text.tspan: Linea semilunaris (lateral edge of rectus abdominis)

text.aria-label: Rectus abdominis — 腹直肌
Origin: pubic symphysis and pubic crest — 起点：耻骨联合和耻骨嵴
text.tspan: Origin: pubic symphysis and pubic crest
起点：耻骨联合和耻骨嵴

text.aria-label: Insertion: xiphoid process and costal cartilages 5–7 — 止点：剑突和第 5–7 肋软骨
text.tspan: Insertion: xiphoid process and costal cartilages 5–7
止点：剑突和第 5–7 肋软骨

text.aria-label: Pyramidalis — 锥状肌
Origin: pubic crest and pubic symphysis — 起点：耻骨嵴和耻骨联合
text.tspan: Origin: pubic crest and pubic symphysis
起点：耻骨嵴和耻骨联合

text.aria-label: Insertion: linea alba — 止点：白线
External abdominal oblique — 腹外斜肌
Origin: outer surfaces of ribs 5–12 — 起点：第 5–12 肋外面
Insertion: linea alba, pubic tubercle, anterior iliac crest — 止点：白线、耻骨结节、髂嵴前部
text.tspan: Insertion: linea alba, pubic tubercle, anterior iliac crest
止点：白线、耻骨结节、髂嵴前部

text.aria-label: Internal abdominal oblique — 腹内斜肌
Origin: thoracolumbar fascia and iliac crest — 起点：胸腰筋膜和髂嵴
text.tspan: Origin: thoracolumbar fascia and iliac crest

text.aria-label: Insertion: ribs 10–12, linea alba, pubic crest — 止点：第 10–12 肋、白线、耻骨嵴
text.tspan: Insertion: ribs 10–12, linea alba, pubic crest
止点：第 10–12 肋、白线、耻骨嵴

text.aria-label: Transversus abdominis — 腹横肌
Origin: costal cartilages 7–12, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest — 起点：第 7–12 肋软骨、胸腰筋膜、髂嵴
text.tspan: Origin: costal cartilages 7–12, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest
起点：第 7–12 肋软骨、胸腰筋膜、髂嵴

text.aria-label: Insertion: linea alba and pubic crest — 止点：白线和耻骨嵴
text.tspan: Insertion: linea alba and pubic crest

text.aria-label: Origin area — 起点区
Insertion area — 止点区
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Muscle outlines are from the 3D model; hatching shows fibre direction. — 肌的轮廓取自 3D 模型；斜线表示纤维方向。
text.tspan: Muscle outlines are from the 3D model; hatching shows fibre direction.
肌的轮廓取自 3D 模型；斜线表示纤维方向。

text.aria-label: Costal cartilages are drawn schematically. — 肋软骨为示意补画。

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
